scenarios.name: Complete Specification with Full Coverage
scenarios.title: Supply of 15 kW Premium Efficiency Induction Motor
clauses: Supply of 15 kW, 415 V +/- 10%, 50 Hz +/- 5%, 4 Pole (1500 RPM synchronous speed) three-phase induction motor.
The motor shall conform to IS 12615:2018 with IE3 efficiency class and continuous duty type S1.
Degree of protection shall be IP55 with Class F insulation and Class B temperature rise.
Mounting arrangement shall be Foot Mounted B3 in accordance with IS 1231.
Testing and loss determination shall be conducted strictly as per IS 15999 (Part 1) with tolerance allowances per IS/IEC 60034-1.
Motor frame and terminal box shall be provided with dual distinct earthing terminals in compliance with IS 3043.
Installation, foundation alignment, and commissioning shall be carried out in accordance with IS 900.
The manufacturer must possess a valid BIS License under Scheme-I and motors must bear the Standard Mark (ISI mark) as mandated by the Electrical Motors QCO.

scenarios.name: Fully Sufficient 30 kW High Performance Specification
scenarios.title: Procurement of 30 kW Induction Motor
clauses: Supply of 30 kW, 415 V +/- 10%, 50 Hz +/- 5%, 4 Pole (1500 RPM) squirrel cage induction motor.
Motor shall conform to IS 12615:2018 with IE3 efficiency class and continuous duty S1.
Degree of protection shall be IP55 with Class F insulation and Class B temperature rise limits.
Mounting arrangement shall be B3 foot mounted conforming to IS 1231.
Loss determination and testing shall be carried out per IS 15999 (Part 1) with tolerance limits as per IS/IEC 60034-1.
Earthing terminals shall be provided on frame and terminal box per IS 3043.
Installation shall follow IS 900 code of practice.
Motor shall bear the Standard Mark (ISI mark) under a valid BIS License as per mandatory Electrical Motors QCO.
